_comment: Single source of truth for push/local notification data `type` values — the contract between backend dispatch and mobile handling. Backend: tests/test_notification_types_contract.py asserts the `backend` list exactly matches the types emitted by notification_helpers.py + session_tasks.py. Mobile: services/notificationRouting.test.ts asserts every listed type has a routing entry. Add a type here FIRST when introducing a new notification, then wire both sides — drift becomes a test failure, not a silently dead handler (this file exists because the original handlers checked type names the backend never emitted).
